name: Skvoz' t'mu lagerja
source: After his first day in Sovyonok, full of worries and surprises, Semyon finally finds himself in his cozy little cabin and goes to sleep. But waking up in the middle of the night, he realizes that things in this camp aren’t quite so simple.
